
 Usage: root [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 MDF CLI — Materials Data Facility

   Options
  --version             -V        Show version and exit
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or customize
                                  the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

   Get started
  login     Authenticate with Globus.
  logout    Clear cached credentials.
  whoami    Show who you are, on which service, and how you are authenticated.
  init      Create an mdf.yaml manifest for a dataset directory.
  doctor    Check your setup: service, connectivity, login, and the local mdf.yaml.

   Find & reuse
  search    Search public datasets.
  show      Show dataset details.
  cite      Get citation for a dataset.
  clone     Download a dataset from MDF.
  related   List datasets related to a given dataset.
  versions  Show version history for a dataset.

   Publish
  check     Run every check `mdf publish --submit` runs, without uploading anything.
  publish   Publish a dataset to MDF Connect.
  status    Check a submission's status (default: your last publish).
  list      List your submitted datasets.
  import    Import a dataset from an external repository or a DataCite DOI.

   Manage
  dataset   Manage your datasets: edit, withdraw, resubmit, diff, open

   More
  admin     Curation and admin commands
  config    Show and change CLI defaults (~/.config/mdf/config.json)
  manifest  Manage mdf.yaml manifest files
  skill     Install the packaged MDF agent skills (Claude, Codex, Gemini)
  mcp       Model Context Protocol server for AI assistants
